basic_profile.bio: A tech enthusiast based in Seattle, WA, with a background in software engineering. I've been a part of the Reddit community for years, contributing mostly to tech-related discussions. My interests include building custom PCs, following the latest in eSports, and binge-watching new series on streaming platforms. I'm employed as a lead developer at a mid-sized tech firm, and I often work remotely. I enjoy spending my free time exploring the outdoors with my partner and our two dogs. I typically browse Reddit during mornings and late evenings.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in computer science and over a decade of experience in software development, I have a deep understanding of tech topics. I've built several custom PCs and have a keen interest in display technologies, which I keep updated through online courses and tech forums.
